speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. To help me understand your fatigue and pallor, have you noticed any unusual bleeding, such as bruising easily or bleeding gums? Also, have you experienced any recent weight loss or night sweats?

speaker: Patient
text: 67-year-old male. The patient complains of a 2-month history of generalized fatigue. He mentions no specific triggers but notes that the fatigue has been progressively worsening. He denies any recent infections, significant weight loss, or night sweats.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any history of alcohol consumption, or have you noticed any abdominal swelling or yellowing of the skin? I would also like to check your abdomen for any organ enlargement.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Generalized fatigue. I also have Appearance of pale skin, Presence of multiple pinpoint, red, nonblanching spots on extremities.

speaker: Doctor
text: The pinpoint red spots you described are likely petechiae, which suggest a low platelet count alongside your anemia. I need to confirm the extent of these blood abnormalities, so REQUEST TEST: Complete_Blood_Count_with_Differential.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the significantly elevated white blood cell count and low platelets, I need to examine the morphology of the cells. REQUEST TEST: Peripheral_Blood_Smear.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Presence of immature cells with large, prominent nucleoli and pink, elongated, needle-shaped cytoplasmic inclusions.

speaker: Doctor
text: The presence of Auer rods in immature cells is pathognomonic for Acute Myeloid Leukemia. DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Myeloid Leukemia
